dedupe_keys.name: replication data for a field experiment on workplace norms and electric vehicle charging etiquette

description: Replication Data for: A Field Experiment on Workplace Norms and Electric Vehicle Charging Etiquette is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. This dataset contains information from 3,395 high resolution electric vehicle charging sessions. The data contains sessions from 85 EV drivers with repeat usage at 105 stations across 25 sites at a workplace charging program. Coverage: the United States. The portal files it under Transportation. Its keywords are electric vehicles. The portal shows 2024-06-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0 1.0 (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
